This new endorsement gives customers the option to purchase OEM coverage. We have listed the endorsement here as not broadening coverage, because the endorsement is optional and is offset by 
the additional premium charge on the Collision and Comprehensive coverages. Please refer to exhibit 21 of our filed rate manual for details on those charges.
We propose using a 10% surcharge on Collision and Comprehensive premium, patterned after the factors currently in use for this endorsement by CSAA in California. The factors are filed with age-based 
splits, as we expect to be able to support such distinctions over time.
Additional premium is offset by the additional coverage provided.
